notes:
Lead background: small mobile-first studio building a social lobby for mid-core mobile titles. Recent seed funding; aggressive Q2 feature push.

Origin: inbound self-serve signup — they tested the quickstart chat example and liked latency & simplicity. Requested AE outreach for pricing + moderation.

Technical summary / reqs:
- Primary workload: real-time lobby chat with short conversational assistant messages and toxic content filtering.
- Target latency: p50 < 150ms for text responses in US region; p95 < 400ms acceptable. Low jitter is important for perceived responsiveness.
- Concurrency: expect 50-200 concurrent active sessions in initial release; planned growth to ~1k concurrent over 6 months for promo days.
- Throughput: avg 8-12 tokens/response per message; spikes to 40-60 tokens on assistant prompts.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; wants to keep monthly inference cost "within low thousands" — asked for clear per-token estimates and fallback options.
- Moderation: need integration with automated safety checks (pre- and post-generation). Want options to call Redwood's moderation model or route to their own rules engine. Must be able to drop messages for obvious spam/abuse quickly.
- Integration preferences: websocket streaming for low-latency UX; fallback to REST for mobile clients. Prefer SDK + code examples.
- Features asked: streaming partial tokens to show typing; server-side rate limiting; per-route quotas; conversation history memory (short-term, 10 messages) and ability to embed select messages for quick search.
- Model preferences: open to small/fast models for everyday chat, larger model for assistant queries. Asked about cost-performance tradeoffs and an easy rollout path.

POC proposal (2 weeks):
- Week 1: wire up hosted_api with websocket streaming in a staging lobby, demo simple assistant reply + pre-filter moderation. Measure tail latency and token costs.
- Week 2: simulate load (50—200 concurrent) and test fallback to cheaper model when cost thresholds crossed; produce short report with perf numbers + recommended configs.

Quotes / direct notes:
- "Latency makes or breaks the lobby experience — anything over ~300ms feels laggy." — Lead engineer, Tom Reyes.
- "We signed up because the quickstart worked — need to validate at our scale and with moderation." — Head of Product, Nora Singh.

Risks / concerns:
- Moderate distrust of automated moderation; wants explicit logs + audit trails for flagged content.
- Cost will determine whether they keep hosted or look at dedicated later.

Attachments / references: pricing + onboarding in Drive (drive:/deals/sapphirelobby/pricing-proposal-v1.pdf). Fireflies transcript id ff_20260302_8b3a. Gmail thread msg-1703829-thread.
